name: @ovaculos/obsidian-cli
description: MCP server for Obsidian — read, write, search, and manage notes via the Obsidian CLI
long_description:
Wraps the Obsidian CLI binary to expose vault operations as MCP tools. Requires Obsidian to be running on the same machine.

## Features

- Read, create, append, prepend, delete, move, and list notes
- Full-text search with optional line context
- Frontmatter property read/write/remove
- Structural analysis: outlines, tags, backlinks, links, orphans, dead ends, unresolved links
- Vault and folder info

## Requirements

Obsidian must be installed and running. The default binary path on macOS is `/Applications/Obsidian.app/Contents/MacOS/obsidian`. Override with the `OBSIDIAN_BIN` environment variable if your install is non-standard.

obsidian_bin.title: Obsidian Binary Path
obsidian_bin.description: Path to the Obsidian binary. Leave blank to use the platform default (/Applications/Obsidian.app/Contents/MacOS/obsidian on macOS, `obsidian` on PATH otherwise).

obsidian_vault.title: Default Vault Name
obsidian_vault.description: Default vault to target. If omitted, uses the active vault in the running Obsidian app.

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read the contents of a note

tools.name: search_context
tools.description: Search the vault for text with line context

tools.name: get_outline
tools.description: Get the heading outline of a note

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List tags in the vault or a file

tools.name: get_backlinks
tools.description: List files that link to a given file

tools.name: get_links
tools.description: List outgoing links from a file

tools.name: list_unresolved
tools.description: List unresolved wikilinks in the vault

tools.name: list_orphans
tools.description: List files with no incoming links

tools.name: list_deadends
tools.description: List files with no outgoing links
